summary.text: On the continent of Otaria, the barbarian Kamahl leaves his mountain home for Cabal City to seek fame as a pit-fighter, drawn by the Mirari, a sphere whose power soon sets Kirtar, Aboshan, Laquatus and Chainer against one another.
The Mirari drives Chainer mad and then drives Kamahl himself to try to unite the barbarians by force, and in his rage he mortally wounds his sister Jeska.
Jeska is cursed by the Cabal Patriarch into the avatar Phage the Untouchable, and the story ends with Kamahl's Soul Reaper slaying Phage and Akroma, whose essences form Karona.
